_note: Project-scoped .mcp.json for dev work in the agentic-ai repo without the plugin marketplace. Servers are anchored on $PWD because Claude Code launches MCP servers with cwd = the directory containing .mcp.json (the project root). The bash wrapper exists so the shell expands $PWD at invocation time — Claude Code's own ${VAR} substitution is reserved for shell environment variables, not for the project directory. Run `pnpm install && pnpm build` (and `cargo build --release -p ai-architect-mcp` for the codebase server) before first launch.

args: BIN="$PWD/packages/codebase-rust/target/release/ai-architect-mcp"; if [ -x "$BIN" ]; then exec "$BIN"; else exec cargo run --quiet --release --manifest-path "$PWD/packages/codebase-rust/Cargo.toml"; fi
